local_proof.preconditions: p is the current missed target; q is the one known next PROBE target. q was resident and the unprotected legal plan a spills it. p!=q and size(p)+size(q)<=M. The alternative other is a legal distinct-SPILL plan retaining q while loading p. Partition sizes do not change between these consecutive probes; data is not deleted.
local_proof.certificate: Every victim x in other has size(x)>M-size(p)-size(q).
local_proof.exact_cover_argument: Every returned victim is impossible beside resident p and q and therefore compulsory. Conversely a legal protected plan cannot leave any other initial resident partition with that property. Thus other contains exactly the compulsory set, and f2 is its minimum immediate write-byte total for the fixed co-residency request.
local_proof.case_p_resident_after_q: If unprotected execution has p and q resident at q service, it must have spilled every compulsory victim by then. Its total writes are at least f2, plus the already executed distinct q spill. It also reads q. The protected execution writes f2 and needs no q read.
local_proof.case_p_not_resident_after_q: p was resident at its own service and absent at q service, so at least one extra size(p)-byte SPILL occurred after the current plan a. q must also be read after a spilled it. Therefore unprotected IO, after cancelling the common initial p read, is at least f1/W+size(q)/R+size(p)/W.
local_proof.acceptance: (f2-f1)/W<=size(q)/R+floor(size(p)/2^shift)/W, shift in {0,1,2}, is sufficient in both cases when the certificate passes. The floor credit never exceeds the necessary size(p)/W in the second case.
local_proof.periodic: Periodic preloading may avoid a q miss but still pays its LOAD and any needed SPILL. In the protected branch the existing periodic PROBE path returns no IO actions when q is already resident.
local_proof.cut: After q service and BEFORE q's own periodic callback.
local_proof.not_claimed: The inherited +1us/d-credit region is unchanged and is not all covered by this certificate. No q-miss penalty is credited. Callback D, unknown future operations and complete Score have no guarantee. The proof uses real arithmetic; float comparisons are not machine-certified.
local_proof.work: Check the old guard, then p-credit, then scan only other: O(|other|), no extra partition scan or expert planning.

example.cost_scope: IO from the current p-miss callback through q service; earlier workload IO is common and excluded.

warning: Certificate proves only additional p-credit acceptance in real-arithmetic p,q prefix IO; no full-Score or machine-certified guarantee.
